_comment: Locales that are supported on purpose without an ISO 639-1 code. Every entry is a decision, not a typo: the tag test and the locale-set expander both read this file, so a non-ISO code is either declared here or the suite goes red.

torbeski.name: Torbeški
torbeski.why: User's native language (Torbeši, Polog/Debar, North Macedonia): a South Slavic variety with no ISO code, no standard orthography and no MT coverage. Native strings come from the user; nothing is machine-invented.
